geometry_replication.frozen_support_rule: geometry replicated if mean rho>=0.70, exact p<0.01, stride-16 difficulty exceeds stride-1 in at least 5 of 6 datasets, and seed-specific blocked mean rho is positive for all three seeds

primary_exact_blocked_test.method: exact convolution of six 8! Spearman rank-permutation distributions

predictor_selection.frozen_selection_rule: G_TOTAL_SELECTED if geometry replicates, G_total has the lowest LOCO RMSE, its RMSE is at least 5% below the runner-up, it beats log2_radius RMSE in at least 5 of 6 held-out corpora, and the identifiability gate passes

scope: out-of-corpus validation of locality and comparison of scalar geometry summaries on six fixed real byte corpora for this learner; not a universal cross-domain law
